evidence: ROUTE 1, per-item published means. Wu et al. (2026) Fig 2 row 'Liking' prints one mean per vase: 4.84 5.35 5.18 3.99 4.93 4.35 3.71 4.47 4.15 3.81 for vases 1-10. Live per-item means (irw_fetch, n=200 each) are 4.83 5.35 5.17 3.99 4.92 4.35 3.71 4.47 4.14 3.81 for Liking_1..Liking_10 -- largest deviation 0.005, tolerance 0.02. The ten published values are all distinct (smallest gap 0.10, vase7 3.71 vs vase10 3.81) and 0 of 20000 random permutations of the observed means match within 0.02, so every code is separated from every other. Direction: the reversed reading (8 - observed) misses the published values by up to 2.70, refuting a flipped 1-7 coding, so resp 1 = 'Strongly Disagree' and resp 7 = 'Strongly Agree' as administered. What this does NOT establish: (a) the shipped item_text is identical for all ten items, so no text permutation is possible in the first place -- what is pinned is the stimulus identity (Liking_n = Fig 1 vase n), and Fig 1 is images with no descriptions; (b) the administered Chinese wording, which is not in the record; (c) the labels of resp 2-6, which the paper never prints.

Route 6 (keying polarity) + route 3 (published totals), n=560 complete cases, run in verify_wu_2024_resilience.R. Route 6: in the raw B1..B6 correlation matrix all 6 same-parity r are positive (+0.461..+0.627) and all 9 cross-parity r are negative (-0.730..-0.461), so {B1,B3,B5} and {B2,B4,B6} are the two polarity classes and the items are stored RAW, matching the BRS's positive/negative alternation. Route 3: scoring resilience as shipped (B1,B3,B5 plus reversed B2,B4,B6 on 1=Strongly Disagree..5=Strongly Agree) reproduces the paper's published r(resilience, SFV addiction) = -0.360 as -0.360, with r(proactive personality, SFV addiction) = -0.408 reproduced as -0.408 as a control; the flipped-anchor reading gives +0.360 and is rejected. Mean resilience 3.207 sits between the paper's Table 2 group means 3.317 / 2.847. This pins which polarity class is the positively-worded one and the anchor direction. It does NOT establish the order within each class: B1/B3/B5 could be any permutation of BRS items 1/3/5 and B2/B4/B6 of items 2/4/6, which rests only on the block being administered in canonical BRS order. Hence PARTIAL.
